correctness.rationale: The graph is the categorical C7×K3: edges join adjacent cycle positions with unequal colors, not the Cartesian product. The source certificate enumerates every one of 5,282 faces including empty, 2,639 matching pairs and four augmented critical faces; a complete 25,242-cover directed-Hasse acyclicity check and signed Morse ∂4=(0,0,0) yield the integral wedge S3∨3S4 after the empty-face/vertex matched pair becomes a critical ordinary vertex. Independently reconstructed the face histogram and mod-two homology dimensions one in degree3, three in degree4. A primitive integral H3 cycle, full signed action across all 84 elements of D7×S3, and reduced signed Lefschetz traces give H3 reflection-sign⊗color-sign and H4 trivial-dihedral⊗(color-sign⊕standard). Independently recomputed all 84 signed simplex Lefschetz traces and checked the predicted character relation, though that is not by itself a second integral H3 cycle proof. Rational transfer gives vanishing positive-degree rational homology of the quotient, not contractibility.
